description: Inline Dock layout snapshot stored in a workspace entity's dock-layout property. Produced by Dock.Serializer.SystemTextJson. A null or structurally invalid object causes the workspace to fall back to default layout.

Id.description: Stable identifier for the root dock container.

VisibleDockables.description: Top-level dockable items in this dock (documents or nested docks).

dockable-ref.description: A reference to a dockable by its Id.

dockable.description: A single dockable item — either a WorkspaceDocument (leaf) or a nested dock (split/proportional).

Id.description: Must match the tab-id of the corresponding workspace-tab-descriptor in the tabs array.

Proportion.description: Fractional width/height of this item in a split layout. Values sum to 1.0 across siblings.

VisibleDockables.description: Child dockables when this item is a nested dock (split panel).
